summary: Verified iter11 bug fixes: Bug 4 (anon client_id-widened history), Bug 5 (unread red-dot badge in sidebar), Bug 6 audit (no FRONTEND_TEST_MSG string in repo). Backend pytest 5/5 pass. Frontend Playwright flow all assertions pass. Light regression (public close, lily open) OK.
critical_code_review_comments: AgentDashboard.jsx is ~862 lines — nearing the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting the sidebar list + customer-info panel into sub-components.

Bug 4 note: since placeholder_email is deterministically derived from client_id, both anon sessions with the same client_id share the SAME email. The widening branch in customer_history is therefore effectively defensive (still correct).
seed_data_creation: Created 3 anon sessions per playwright run (2 same-cid, 1 distinct). Test DB purged before each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin user (admin@livechat.com) is routed to /admin, not /dashboard. Use agent@livechat.com/agent123 to test AgentDashboard flows. Sidebar items expose data-testid='session-item-<id>'. Composer testids: agent-input, agent-send-btn.
